chrome-yellow.notes: Category hue at palette position 0; currently claimed by AI/. resolveHue() derives its window-head fill (printable, deepened in dark), the ink printed on it (inkOn) and its ink-on-paper (inkFor, mixed toward the page ink until it clears 4.5:1 on every surface).

teal.notes: Category hue at palette position 1; currently container/. resolveHue() derives its window-head fill (printable, deepened in dark), the ink printed on it (inkOn) and its ink-on-paper (inkFor, mixed toward the page ink until it clears 4.5:1 on every surface).

ultramarine.notes: Category hue at palette position 2; currently script/. resolveHue() derives its window-head fill (printable, deepened in dark), the ink printed on it (inkOn) and its ink-on-paper (inkFor, mixed toward the page ink until it clears 4.5:1 on every surface).

grass.notes: Category hue at palette position 3 (reserve). resolveHue() derives its window-head fill (printable, deepened in dark), the ink printed on it (inkOn) and its ink-on-paper (inkFor, mixed toward the page ink until it clears 4.5:1 on every surface).

oxide-orange.notes: Category hue at palette position 4 (reserve). resolveHue() derives its window-head fill (printable, deepened in dark), the ink printed on it (inkOn) and its ink-on-paper (inkFor, mixed toward the page ink until it clears 4.5:1 on every surface).

violet.notes: Category hue at palette position 5 (reserve). resolveHue() derives its window-head fill (printable, deepened in dark), the ink printed on it (inkOn) and its ink-on-paper (inkFor, mixed toward the page ink until it clears 4.5:1 on every surface).

sienna.notes: Category hue at palette position 6 (reserve). resolveHue() derives its window-head fill (printable, deepened in dark), the ink printed on it (inkOn) and its ink-on-paper (inkFor, mixed toward the page ink until it clears 4.5:1 on every surface).

binder-tan.notes: The hue of everything that belongs to no category — posts, tools, pages — and the default accent and window-head fill. A tan with chroma on purpose: a hue with none, mixed toward warm paper, only bleaches it.

vermilion.notes: Danger only: the sudo flag, WARNING / CAUTION alerts, the 404 panel. Held out of the hue palette so it can never be mistaken for a category.

vermilion-dark.notes: Dark-mode vermilion. A light salmon, so the ink printed on it is the dark ink (#16150F), not white.

paper-light.notes: The only ground in light mode, under the --tooth grain. Ink #16150F / #4D4937 / #635E49.

paper-dark.notes: The only ground in dark mode, under the --tooth grain.

ink-light.notes: Light-mode primary ink. Secondary #4D4937, tertiary #635E49 — the tertiary was moved to clear 4.5:1 on a recess over aged paper.

ink-dark.notes: Dark-mode primary ink. Secondary #BAB4A2, tertiary #A29D8B — the tiers sit close because the quietest must still clear 4.5:1 on a yellowed recess.

display.purpose: Page titles and a script README's own H1, the largest line on the site. Archivo at width 82, caps, balanced wrap. The home page's site name is set larger still.

headline.purpose: H2. Archivo at width 88, over a strong rule; the rule collapses when a markdown --- precedes it.

subtitle.purpose: H4-H6. Body size; family and weight carry the rank, not a second scale.

body.purpose: Every word meant to be read. One size for the whole site, 75ch measure, which lands Traditional Chinese at about 34 characters per line.

label.purpose: Chivo Mono caps, 12px. Only for things a machine said or measured: dates, categories, status, byte counts, language names, the copy button.

code.purpose: The punched window's contents. Three inks only: what the machine runs, what it is told to run, and incidental syntax dropped back.

derivedTokens.mechanism: site/src/lib/design.mjs derives every colour; colorCss() renders it as text and site/src/layouts/Base.astro inlines it into <head>. No stylesheet holds a colour literal, so the value the contrast script measures is the value that ships.

properties.name: --paper, --ink, --ink-2, --ink-3
properties.purpose: The ground and its three inks, per theme.

properties.name: --recess, --rule, --rule-strong
properties.purpose: The ink at low alpha: the well under a code window, table head or inline code; hairline; strong hairline.

properties.name: --danger, --on-danger, --danger-ink, --danger-field
properties.purpose: Vermilion as fill, the ink printed on it, vermilion as text on every surface, and its low-alpha field.

properties.name: --age-0..2
properties.purpose: Washes laid over the paper for a page that is a quarter / three quarters old.

properties.name: --fill, --on-fill, --accent
properties.purpose: Default window-head fill, the ink printed on it, and the accent ink. Overridden by .hue-N on a script page.

properties.name: .hue-0 … .hue-6
properties.purpose: One class per palette hue, applied to a category's subtree.

contrastFloor.min: 4.5:1 for every pair asserted; no pair is held to the 3:1 large-text allowance
assertedPairs: primary / secondary / tertiary ink on every surface in surfacesFor(): the paper, the recess, the danger field, and each again on paper aged to step 1 and 2 (tertiary is not held to the danger field it never sits on)
danger as ink (inkFor) on every surface
inkOn()'s chosen ink on each hue's window-head fill, all 7 hues plus the binder, both themes
each hue as ink (inkFor) on every surface
the ink printed on a vermilion fill (the sudo flag, a failed copy), both themes
the emitted stylesheet: three theme blocks defining the same properties; a .hue-N class per hue
ageOf() steps at 10 / 89 / 90 / 269 / 270 days, a Date input, no date, a malformed date

motion.name: hinge
motion.purpose: The only motion value in the system, used for hover and press. Nothing eases and nothing fades; prefers-reduced-motion turns it off.

breakpoints.name: aside
breakpoints.purpose: The document layout becomes minmax(0, 880px) + 232px: the contents move to a sticky column and the related links sit beside the text. Below it, contents collapse into a block above the text and the related links fall below it.

breakpoints.name: row
breakpoints.purpose: A row's lead column folds above its title.

breakpoints.name: contrast
breakpoints.purpose: Syntax tokens that use the hue as ink step back to plain ink.

texture.value: an inline SVG feTurbulence fractalNoise tile, baseFrequency 0.9, 4 octaves, desaturated, opacity 0.09, 180x180
texture.blend: multiply in light, screen in dark
texture.purpose: Paper tooth. The whole page carries it, as the body background; a gradient cannot be a texture.

narrative.overview:
這個世界是一本寫在暖色紙上的手札：一種墨、髮絲線，沒有卡片、沒有陰影、沒有漸層。列表是一張紙被髮絲線切成一行一行。整個畫面只有一個飽和的東西 —— 被打孔切穿的指令視窗，而它的顏色不是裝飾，是這條指令的出處：腳本頁上是該腳本所屬分類的顏色，文章裡是裝訂布的褐。

這個設計繼承自前一版「盒裝軟體參考手冊」。那個外框為三個分類的手冊設計，裝不下一條隨時間長長的文章列表，所以拿掉了；留下來的是它最好的部分 —— 字體系統、紙紋、被算出來的色彩、指令視窗、頁面老化，以及「狀態用記號不用色相」。
keyCharacteristics: 一張連續的紙；層級靠髮絲線、留白與字重，不靠陰影或卡片。
顏色全部算出來（src/lib/design.mjs），樣式表裡沒有任何色碼。
分類色按位置指派，永遠不按名稱；七色在冊，目前用三色。
朱紅被整個抽離出色盤，只花在危險上。
動態只有一種文法：90ms steps(2, end) 的兩格鉸鏈。
狀態用記號加文字表示：方塊、圓、摺痕、打孔。
前端只持有 chrome；散文一律是 markdown 檔。

rules.name: The Derived Colour Rule
rules.body: paper、ink、rule、recess、danger、fill、accent 與 .hue-N 全部由 colorCss() 生成並內嵌進 <head>。樣式表只消費它們。想加一個顏色語意，加的是推導規則，不是色票。

rules.name: The Position-Not-Name Rule
rules.body: 分類色按順序中的位置指派，永遠不按名稱。

rules.name: The Vermilion Reserve Rule
rules.body: 朱紅只有一個意思：這會弄壞讀者的機器，或這一頁不存在。

rules.name: The Every-Surface Rule
rules.body: 墨要在紙上、凹槽上、老化的紙上、危險底上都 ≥ 4.5:1。surfacesFor() 列出所有這些底，推導與測試都走同一份清單。

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: 散文永遠不超過 75ch；表格與指令視窗取整條閱讀欄寬。

rules.name: The One-List Rule
rules.body: 文章、工具、腳本、標籤頁、搜尋結果用同一個 .row。

rules.name: The Two-Frame Hinge Rule
rules.body: 全站只有一種動態文法：--hinge: 90ms steps(2, end)。沒有 easing、沒有 fade、沒有 smooth scroll。

dos: Do 讓新的顏色語意經過 design.mjs 的推導函式，而不是新增手調色票。
Do 為新增的分類只做一件事：新增一個頂層資料夾。
Do 在改動色相、墨色或底之後跑 npm test。
Do 用記號（形狀）加文字表達狀態。
Do 為新的內容種類重用 .row、.tags、.status 與 .prose。
donts: Don't 在任何 CSS 裡寫色碼或 rgb()。
Don't 把任何分類名稱綁到特定色相；指派永遠按位置。
Don't 把朱紅用在危險以外的任何地方。
Don't 加入 easing、fade、transition: all、smooth scroll 或任何超過兩格的動畫。
Don't 用陰影或卡片堆疊來分隔內容。
Don't 只用顏色表達狀態。
Don't 在 .astro / .ts 裡寫任何頁面散文，也不要在腳本頁加任何 README 沒說過的字。
